item.title: Why Traditional Batch Renamers Fail on Cyclic Collisions: Inside KyteRename's 3-Stage DAG Engine
item.description: Renaming 001.jpg to 002.jpg while renaming 002.jpg to 001.jpg causes naive batch renamers to crash or overwrite files. Here is how KyteRename uses Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) topological sorting to guarantee zero overwrites.
